note: Family-owned campground near Triadelphia (Ohio Co, near Wheeling); pool/hot tub. Nearly every site fronts the on-site creek (with a small waterfall) - creekfront RV sites confirmed. --Claude
summary: Hookups (50/30A, water, sewer) and 14 sites confirmed manual from the operator's site; added booking (phone/email). No rate anywhere on the site, so fees stay empty. Note: dropped the site-count/hookup restatement.
flags: No posted nightly rate: the operator's site (last modified 2019-03-25) gives none, and the 2026-10-16 price pass found none either; the only price indicator is RV Life's $$ tier. Presence passes (working site with phone 304-547-1469; Google Maps 4.6 stars, 58 reviews, same phone). Long-stay test: 14 sites, owners on the premises and no posted nightly rate - can't confirm nights are sold to passing travellers; a call would settle it.
